title: nebuRedaction detection unit
description: One attribute of one log record, with the context needed to classify it. Work order NR-0001 §2.1; plan §7.3. One JSON object per line in a JSON Lines file. FROZEN AT v1.0 by NR-0002 §2.3 item 1 (gate G1): any change to this schema must raise the version and be declared in the evaluation report, per EXECUTION.md §8.

key.description: The attribute name. Fragments cut out of a message body use the <slot:...> form.

value.description: The attribute value, always a string even when it denotes a number.

label.description: One of the seven v0.1 classes (plan §3.2). Absent for unlabelled data; null is not permitted, omit the field instead.

template.description: The message template the attribute appeared in.

scope.description: Scope or origin type, such as otel.attribute, config.env, http.header or message.kv.

family.description: Format family, such as aws.access_key_id or neg.uuid_v4. Dataset splits are made by family (plan §5.3).

ambiguous.description: True when the value alone cannot settle the label (plan §3.3), so the label follows the bias-toward-redaction convention.

source.description: Where the unit came from. Third-party sources carry their dataset name and are barred from training and labeling paths.

meta.description: Provenance. Open-ended, but these keys have fixed meanings when present.

generator_version.description: Version of the synthetic generator that produced the unit.

seed.description: The seed that produced this unit's value, so a single record can be regenerated.

adversarial.description: True for a negative whose key name or template contains a credential-suggesting word while the value is not a credential (NR-0001 §2.2 item 4).

context.description: How the key name relates to the value: whether it points at the right answer, says nothing, or points the wrong way.

split.description: The split this unit was generated for.

held_out_family.description: True when the unit's family is one of the families held out of training to test generalisation to unseen formats.

source_line.description: Line number in the originating third-party file.

source_file.description: Path of the originating third-party file, relative to its dataset root.

original_label.description: The label as the originating dataset expressed it, before mapping to the seven classes.
